title: alea-intake — Persona UAT Campaign (live validation)
spend: app-side ~$1-2 est. (gpt-4o-mini, 3 full 3-persona pipeline runs + probes; 60 failed JSON-mode calls billed ~0)

sections.title: Campaign result — gates summary
sections.context: Gates per persona: `landlord-tenant` 4/6 (fail RUB-08, RUB-09) `immigration` 3/6 (fail RUB-01, RUB-08, RUB-09) `family-custody` 3/6 (fail RUB-01, RUB-08, RUB-09) All failures share two systemic roots: deadline computation (BUG-12) and issue-completeness / exploration quality. The 8-10 persona expansion was deliberately NOT run this campaign (policy 5 — gates not clear). 5 new personas were authored and committed, ready to run once gates clear: consumer-debt, wage-theft, benefits-denial, employment-discrimination, elder-exploitation.

sections.title: Bugs found and FIXED this campaign (deployed to dev)
sections.context: Fixed and deployed to Railway alea-intake-dev this campaign: BUG-3 — dev LLM key/model misconfigured; added Railway vars + new ALEA_LLM_PROVIDER / ALEA_LLM_MODEL / ALEA_LLM_API_KEY env overrides, set to gpt-4o-mini per policy 5. BUG-4 — LLM client called with the wrong API shape at every seam (positional messages args; calls to a nonexistent LLMService.json_async that raised AttributeError , silently swallowed). BUG-6 — OpenAI JSON-mode's "contains the word 'json'" requirement was unmet, killing the gap and question-generation stages outright. BUG-7 — extraction prompt never named the schema …

sections.title: Bugs found, OPEN (next iteration)
sections.context: BUG-12 — deadline year-anchor: the LLM extracts trigger dates with the wrong year (e.g. 2023-06-15 for a Jun 15, 2026 event) because the prompt gives it no 'today' anchor. computed_date comes back null even for verbatim dates (an Aug 20, 2026 hearing still resolves to 'date unclear'). rule_id / citation are null everywhere — the rules table is never wired through. This is the root cause of the RUB-08/RUB-09 gate failures across all three personas. BUG-13 — FOLIO adjacency exploration spam: roughly 32 of 47 immigration claims are ontology-traversal noise, including a literal 'ZZZ - SANDBOX: UN…

sections.title: Deterministic sidecars (memo_checks.py + folio_check.py)
sections.context: `folio_check --all`: 86/86 mapped IRIs resolve, are non-deprecated, and are well-rooted in the taxonomy. Exports: pdf + json verified for all 9 memos (3 profiles x 3 personas). Flesch-Kincaid reading grades: `court_self_help` scored 17.1 (landlord-tenant) / 23.3 (immigration) / 20.8 (family-custody) against a ~6 target. Deadline digests show wrong-year trigger dates and null computed dates across all three personas — the deterministic evidence underlying BUG-12. Scripts committed to the repo: `scripts/memo_checks.py`, `scripts/folio_check.py`.
